adopt: Separate the SQL type input entry point from checked integer conversion.
reject_or_boundary: Do not import PostgreSQL context/ereport allocation or DB types into the pure SQL frontend.

adopt: Explicitly handle the asymmetric signed range: negative magnitude 2^63 is valid while positive magnitude 2^63 is not.
Keep format and numeric-range failures distinct.
reject_or_boundary: Do not inherit hexadecimal/octal/binary prefixes, underscores or general whitespace acceptance; the XADB AST already separates sign and decimal digits.
Do not copy the C converter; derive bounded Rust checked arithmetic with cancellation checkpoints.

adopt: Length is explicit, rather than requiring NUL termination.
reject_or_boundary: PostgreSQL typmod counts characters and permits truncating trailing spaces. XADB limits UTF8 bytes and preserves all trailing spaces without clipping.

adopt: Length-delimited copying represents a zero-length text payload separately from SQL NULL.
reject_or_boundary: This PostgreSQL text representation is not the XADB SQL empty-text rule: XADB normalizes only SQL input empty Utf8, preserving its type; native empty text remains a value.

adopt: Use explicit input byte bounds and distinguish the exact signed 2^63 boundary; leading zeros must not produce a false overflow.
Hex decode requires validated ASCII hex and exactly two nibbles per byte.
reject_or_boundary: Do not adopt wrapped accumulation, saturated result outputs or special success/error integers; XADB returns typed Range without a partial scalar.
Do not call a hex helper whose validation exists only as assertions. XADB must validate the P2 raw Binary payload before decode.

adopt: Retain explicit byte length, separate null from zero-length text/blob, and check length before payload allocation.
reject_or_boundary: The implementation may replace the destination with NULL on overlength at lines 1319-1328; XADB failure must preserve previously returned/retained outputs.
NUL-terminated strlen input and encoding/BOM conversion are not the XADB UTF8 byte-slice contract.
Numeric/text affinity converts strings and numbers. XADB must check original SQL type and reject implicit conversion, including empty Utf8 into Int64.

adopt: Even-hex validation is a necessary condition before blob decode.
reject_or_boundary: SQLite validates blob hex in tokenization. XADB P2 intentionally retains unchecked Binary tokens, so P3 must perform this check itself.
The inspected parser entry clears connection interruption state; XADB uses per-call borrowed controls and must not clear a caller cancellation token.

adopt: Treat negative 2^63 explicitly and allow arbitrary leading zeros under the source bound.
Numeric end position and overflow are separate observations.
reject_or_boundary: The helper accepts unsigned positive range, prefix consumption and saturated error outputs. XADB requires all decimal digits and signed i64 bounds without saturation.
The null-terminated path uses a 65535-byte guard; XADB AST digits can be longer within the 1 MiB source limit and need bounded processing rather than this foreign cap.

adopt: Empty-text conversion belongs to the SQL input boundary, not the underlying storage value representation.
reject_or_boundary: MariaDB mode-driven conversion creates Item_null while literal construction may also convert charsets. XADB has fixed UTF8 semantics and must retain Utf8 type before nullability checks.

adopt: Literal and parameter input paths must apply the intended empty-input rule consistently.
reject_or_boundary: Both string and blob setup take MODE_EMPTY_STRING_IS_NULL. XADB empty Binary is always a real zero-byte Binary value; do not copy the broader mode rule.
Do not depend on mutable THD modes or query logging during pure scalar conversion.
Field conversion can report warning/note after truncation and treat lost trailing spaces specially. XADB validates before publication, does not truncate, and preserves trailing spaces.

adopt: The sequence grammar demonstrates special handling of signed minimum rather than negating an unrepresentable positive i64.
reject_or_boundary: This is sequence metadata grammar, not an XADB scalar implementation recipe or proof of identical SQL semantics.

foundation_findings.finding: Value::Null has no logical type; Utf8(String)/Bytes(Vec) own uncharged cloneable payloads. SQL needs a separate typed, quota-backed owner and must not alter foundation semantics.
validate uses byte length and maps values over 65536 to LimitExceeded; it does not enforce target column length/nullability or SQL empty-input normalization.

compare validates sizes, then returns UNKNOWN if either is Null before comparing variant discriminants. SQL predicate preparation still needs complete typed validation, especially for typed NULL; index total ordering is separate.

independent_design_concerns: Keep untyped literal NULL, typed SQL/bind NULL, empty Utf8 SQL input and non-NULL native empty Utf8 distinct. Check original type before SQL-only empty-text normalization, then nullability/byte length.

Prefer literal conversion selected through (&ParsedStatement,node index) rather than independently supplied source/ScalarSyntax/span. A public raw-parts API would need full consistency checks. Define rejection of non-scalar nodes, out-of-bounds indices and unbound Parameter explicitly.

Checked negative accumulation (multiply by ten and subtract each digit, then checked negation only for nonnegative syntax) is an independently derived Rust option that represents i64::MIN directly. Long zero prefixes remain valid and require checkpoints.
Do not apply scalar i64 conversion to DDL type_length; those raw signed digits stay deferred until the DDL semantic owner after precommit.

Validate/count Text and Binary before allocation, then allocate exact decoded size under shared ledgers and decode with bounded checkpoints. Charge observed actual capacity; keep prior scalar/AST owners alive and charged.

Text removes doubled ASCII quote escapes only; backslash, spaces, U+0000 and other valid UTF8 bytes remain. Binary requires raw even ASCII hex; do not text-unescape doubled quotes into a supposedly valid binary.

Whole str.parse::<i64>(), String::from_utf8(full_vec) and unbounded decode/compare loops cannot expose the frozen 256-byte cancellation checkpoints. Use bounded processing, or retain verified UTF8 as charged bytes and avoid an uncontrolled whole-payload conversion.
Freeze Value module plus Type/Range/NotNull diagnostic variants, scalar/target length mappings, malformed/odd-hex precedence, malformed metadata behavior and spans before implementation.
Keep scalar outputs non-Clone, private owned payload/leases and readonly views; no detached foundation::Value or uncharged clone route in the product conversion API.
Scalar checks do not prove atomic bind_all, complete AST value checking or full predicate typing. Those callers must consume every required validation result and preserve old binding on any failure.
suggested_independent_cases: Signed min/max and both adjacent failures; +0/-0; very long leading zeros; cancellation/deadline during zero scan; sign/trivia/digits origin spans.
Utf8 empty -> typed NULL; Utf8 empty to Int64 -> Type before nullability; typed NULL of wrong type -> Type; native empty remains non-NULL; empty Binary remains a value.
Text escape pairs, ordinary backslash, trailing spaces, U+0000, multibyte byte counts and decoded 65535/65536/65537 boundaries; quote-heavy raw length differs from decoded length.
Binary empty, mixed-case hex, odd nibble count, first invalid ASCII/non-ASCII character, doubled quote, embedded whitespace, decoded size boundary and competing malformed/overlength errors.
Shared session/database quota residual -1/exact/+1; actual allocation padding/excess reservation failure; cancellation in count/decode/copy; retained scalar/source/AST and prior output preservation.
Known-bad conversion/type-erasure/empty-Binary-to-null/trim/wrap/truncate/missing-checkpoint/lease-release mutants; no rerun of unchanged lexer/parser/foundation cases.

api_draft_review.read_scope: Full draft, public API through required fixtures
api_draft_review.assessment: Implementation feasible; no additional public API required. Product implementation remains deferred until D2 and fixture freeze.
api_draft_review.bounded_string_construction: For AST Text, validate each source UTF8 scalar with std::str::from_utf8 over its 1..4 bytes, then push_str into the exactly reserved String; handle doubled ASCII quotes separately. Check after at most 252 accumulated raw bytes so a 4-byte step still gives an interval at most 255. No final full-payload UTF8 conversion is required.
api_draft_review.borrowed_string_copy: Input &str already guarantees UTF8. End each copy chunk at <=256 bytes, retreating at most three bytes to a character boundary, then push_str into preallocated output.
error_precedence_suggestions: Binary: after 65536 valid decoded bytes, one valid dangling nibble is Syntax, a next pair containing a nonhex nibble is Syntax, and only a fully valid 65537th pair establishes Range. Freeze independent boundary examples.
Copy APIs must preserve caller at for all controls and diagnostics, including nonzero, reversed or very large offsets; do not add offsets or clamp as though a SQL source existed.
api_draft_review.control_detector_suggestion: copy_sql/copy_native use unchanged caller spans, so internal cancellation witnesses need checkpoint counts and charged-capacity observations rather than increasing source offset. Literal count versus charged decode can be distinguished by shared ledger usage.
